page.layout: Margin notes down the left margin, four notes in order from top to bottom. Page number at the top left.; One page of text: a single boxed table of consuls, names in the left column and years in the right column, with horizontal rules between the year groups. Running head above the table. Catchword at the lower right, below the table.

note.i: Privilegium Vl-traject. in quatuor casib[?]. Ecclesiast.
Die Conv .Apostol. Bertholdus de Gilez-werth. Domicellus in Cronebeke præfe-stus in Groninge Folkerus Iustitiari-us ibidem.
Initium belli: in-ter Groning. & vi-cinos in agro.

page.notes: The first note's blot covers two letters, read as [illegible, ~2 letters]. "casib[?]" is uncertain: the word may read "casib" or differ slightly. Each year stands beside its group of four consuls and is placed on the first line of that group. Printed rules separate the groups; they are not text. The running head is set above the table. Old-style numerals in the years are copied as 1325 to 1332. The catchword "Reinol-" is hyphenated as printed.
